facts.activity_file: identifying every energy source for a task

consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: application of positive isolation devices and personal locks

hazard_media: stored potential of an elevated component
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: improvement notice - critical safeguard at CV-3103

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks had been bypassed, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks on CV-3103 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in planning and permitting an isolation, specifically identifying every energy source for a task. CV-3103 (plant conveyors) is in service for coarse ore and reclaim conveying. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks had been bypassed. The gravity energy involved is held as suspended load, and the recorded presentation was fall, collapse, crush.
response.summary: On 12 February 2013 a regulatory notice was issued concerning CV-3103 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility following start-up after maintenance.
